name: Creatine Monohydrate
effects: Phosphocreatine replenishment — ATP regeneration during high-intensity effort
One of the most studied and effective sports supplements
Cognitive benefit investigated — NMDA co-agonist properties; benefits brain energy metabolism
Water retention of 1-2 kg during loading (intramuscular)
Loading protocol (20g/day for 5 days) saturates faster; 3-5g/day reaches saturation in ~28 days
Creatinine elevation on labs — not indicative of kidney damage in healthy individuals
